definitions: An implement with two or more prongs, used for lifting food to the mouth or holding it when cutting.
A place where a road, river, or other linear feature divides into two or more parts.
A tool with a handle and a set of tines, used for digging or lifting.
In chess, a situation in which a single piece attacks two or more of the opponent's pieces simultaneously.
examples: Eat your peas with a fork.
Take the left fork in the road.
He used a garden fork to turn the soil.
